0.npc_text: Ahoy! Captain Elias at your service. What tales do you bring?

elias_ask_root.npc_text: Ask away. A harbor without stories is only wet wood.

player_choices.text: Tell me about the ships coming through Driftwatch.

elias_ask_ships.npc_text: Coasters, pearl boats, fishing hulls, smugglers pretending not to be smugglers. A port's character is written in its wake, and Driftwatch has always drawn rougher ink than most.
